Probably one claim per unique claim. The evidence span can be first "Doesn't work". If include duplicate, maybe not needed.

      "primary_topic": "function_performance",

But exact evidence "No one has time for that." Primary convenience_value secondary general_convenience polarity negative. Is that a product claim? It references usability. Could be included. But if we include two overlapping claims maybe okay. However likely expected claims are "doesn't work" and "takes too much time to angle phone right". Keep minimal.

Need no extra text. Final.
